## Cause

`bin/aspec_platform/savings.py` computed savings backwards:

```python
naive = int(size / weights["bytes_per_token"])   # whole-file reads, as tokens
graph = int(reads * weights["context_bytes"] / weights["bytes_per_token"])  # cheap graph context
saved = max(graph - naive, 0)                    # always 0 when graph < naive
```

The graph approach costs much less than the whole-file reads it replaces, so `graph - naive` is negative and the `max(..., 0)` clamp turned it into 0. The Home KPI reads `saved_tokens` from this function, so it showed 0.

## Fix

In `bin/aspec_platform/savings.py`, the line is now:

```python
saved = max(naive - graph, 0)
```

This matches the existing test expectations, which I did not change: 12000 naive − 76 graph = 11924 saved, and the editable-weights case gives (24000 − 100) × 5 × 10 / 1e6 USD.

The change is one call, `mask_email(text)`, placed right after the URL-credential pass. Placement matters: `https://bob:s3cretpw@github.com/...` would otherwise match the email pattern.
